project_label_mapping: BEFORE or AFTER, with direction normalized
rationale: ChronoCTI groups BEFORE/AFTER and immediate variants into one BEFORE class; retain source direction and immediacy separately if used.
ChronoCTI defines SIM-OV as simultaneous actions whose implementations overlap. The project's OVERLAP is close; SIMULTANEOUS may require a narrower interval interpretation.

project_label_mapping: CONCURRENT_UNSPECIFIED only where independent simultaneous actions are source-supported
rationale: ChronoCTI distinguishes concurrent but independent actions; do not equate this with an unresolved/vague claim.

project_label_mapping: NO_TEMPORAL_CLAIM only for a pair actually assessed under a frozen candidate-pair rule
rationale: Missing or unassessed pairs are not negative labels.
